features: ULTRA SLIM CREDIT CARD DESIGN – Compact wallet-style design that is easy to carry in your wallet, pocket, handbag or laptop bag.

WIDE DEVICE COMPATIBILITY – Compatible with USB-enabled laptops, desktop computers, TVs, car music systems and other compatible devices. Mobile/tablet use may require a suitable OTG adapter depending on the device.
PORTABLE & LIGHTWEIGHT – Credit-card-inspired slim body makes it convenient to carry while travelling, working or studying.
MULTI-PURPOSE STORAGE – Suitable for personal files, office documents, study materials, photos, videos, music and backups.
IDEAL FOR GIFTING – Stylish and practical storage accessory suitable for students, professionals, employees, clients and corporate gifting.
